title: CAN-Bus-Aussetzer — ein offener Draht zählt, ein rauer Bus nicht
summary: The transmission's traffic is fully swallowed for 1.2 s (the gateway latches U0101), then only 40 % is lost (it must not latch again). One code, two bus conditions, two verdicts.

dtc.because: 1.2 s of silence on a wire with a 400 ms timeout is a lost node
the wire carries again, so the monitor heals the code without clearing it
a 40 % frame loss never keeps the gateway silent for a whole timeout window, so a rough bus must not be re-reported as a dead module

time_ms.because: the run is long enough for the heal window to have passed twice
